{{Quote|General Grievous, you have defeated me and taken control of my ship. Congratulations. However, if you're watching this message, that means I'm boarding an escape pod and shall soon be safely away from the ship, which is about to self-destruct.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, in a holographic transmission left for General Grievous|<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />}}
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] '''attacked''' a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under the command of his longtime enemy, [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], in the [[20 BBY/Legends|third year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Launching a surprise [[Space warfare/Legends|assault]] on Kenobi's three-[[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] fleet in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Grievous's armada gained a swift advantage, with the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] and [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] summarily eliminating the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and their outmatched [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]. When Grievous arrived with a boarding party of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']], Kenobi mounted a defense of his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship's]] main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] with [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], designated CC-2224, and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]. Yet Kenobi was unable to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|defeat]] Grievous in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and ordered all [[Troop/Legends|troop]] personnel to evacuate from the ''Negotiator'', which he conceded to Grievous's control.

Before jettisoning from the ''Negotiator'' aboard [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody and their men, Kenobi activated his crippled flagship's [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct sequence]], forcing Grievous to abandon the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] aboard a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] before he could plunder the military intelligence stored in its [[Computer/Legends|computer]] databanks. The destruction of Kenobi's fleet prevented him from sending Cody to aid [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had been [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|captured]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] while overseeing a [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] mission with a class of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Their coordinates put them dangerously close to Florrum. I do not want them getting any ideas. You will need to leave quickly, Cody.''"<br />"''Sir, enemy fleet's coming out of hyperspace!''"<br />"''Battle stations! Launch all fighters! Cody, looks like you're staying here for now.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and a clone naval officer|<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />}}
[[File:KenobiAndTheYounglings-BFR.png|thumb|left|300px|Kenobi prepares to dispatch Cody to rescue the Jedi Initiates aboard the ''Crucible''.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the third [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Date" /> [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was out on patrol with a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] when<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /> his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']],<ref name="Explore: Bound for Rescue" /> was hailed by the [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training cruiser]] [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']]. Kenobi learned from the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]]&mdash;who spoke for her fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-in-[[Jedi training/Legends|training]], [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]], and [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]]&mdash;that their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] had been [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|raided]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who had attempted to steal their valuable supply of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] from the<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Nexus of Power">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. Having failed to pilfer the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], Ohnaka had instead captured the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings']] chaperone, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to sell her for profit. The damaged ''Crucible'' had subsequently been stranded near the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], the site of Ohnaka's [[Hondo's complex/Legends|base]].<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

With his task force being the only one in a position to respond,<ref name="Facebook Chee: Location">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=492557564098508&id=201820953172172&comment_id=20424733&offset=0&total_comments=3|name=[[Leland Chee]]|date=2012-11-26|quote=The site of the space battle isn't established beyond the fact that Obi-Wan's fleet is the only one that can respond to the youngling's distress call. It's far off enough that Obi-Wan was going to send Cody off separately to help the younglings.|nobackup=1}}</ref> Kenobi decided to send his [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]], [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], to rescue the younglings and then mount a mission to save Tano. Before [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody, designated CC-2224, could depart from the ''Negotiator'', [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched a surprise [[Space warfare/Legends|attack]]<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /> aimed at [[Death/Legends|killing]] Kenobi, a longtime foe of his.<ref name="Explore: Bound for Rescue" /> Kenobi's position in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] consequently became the site of a fierce engagement with Grievous's opposing fleet from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]].<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

==The attack==
===Ambushing the Republic===
{{Quote|Our forces are being overrun. The droids are sending out boarding parties.''"<br />"''We must get to the main hangar to repel them.|A clone naval officer reports to General Kenobi|<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />}}
[[File:BoardingParty-BFR.png|thumb|right|290px|Grievous leads a boarding party to the ''Negotiator'' just as another cruiser explodes.]]
Grievous exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with a fleet comprising two [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyers]], a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]], and two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. While all five [[Warship/Legends|Warships]] bore down on Kenobi's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and hammered out [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]], the [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] launched [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] to do battle with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Navy/Legends|naval]] forces. When a [[Unidentified clone naval officer (Negotiator)|bridge officer]] reported the Separatists' arrival, Kenobi immediately ordered his [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officer]] crew and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] to their battle stations, deploying the entirety of his task force's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement against the Separatists. [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] and [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighters]] engaged the Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]], with dogfights breaking out around the larger warships. One of the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]],<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /> "[[Killer/Legends|Killer]],"<ref name="Explore: Bound for Rescue" /> shot down a pursuant Vulture droid by cutting the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of his Z-95 starfighter to maneuver behind the droid. Other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] did not have as much success, with their starfighters being blasted apart by enemy units.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

While the Republic and Confederate [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] fought ship-to-ship, the Republic task force also sent its escort [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]]&mdash;a pair each of [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruisers]] and [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruisers]]&mdash;into the fray. Due to their smaller size, the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light]] and escort cruisers were able to press forward to confront the Confederate battleships at a closer range. Although cruisers from both armadas sustained damage, Grievous's surprise attack quickly overwhelmed Kenobi and his [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]], with ship after ship falling to the Separatists. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general pressed his all-out assault, setting out with a boarding party to confront the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] aboard the ''Negotiator''.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

[[File:Engle_Crashes.jpg|thumb|left|290px|Engel crashes into the hangar of the ''Negotiator''.]]
Upon learning of the inbound boarding action from a [[Unidentified clone naval officer 2 (Negotiator)|naval officer]], Kenobi ordered all of his embarked 212th [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to the main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], where they would mount a defense to repel the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Grievous's [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] was escorted to the ''Negotiator'' by [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]], [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]], more Vulture droids, and [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunships]], the latter of which transported the boarding [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]. The Vulture droids cleared a path by shooting down Killer's Z-95 starfighter and then the BTL-B Y-wing starfighter<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /> of clone pilot "[[Engle/Legends|Engle]],"<ref name="Explore: Bound for Rescue" /> which crashed in the ''Negotiator''{{'s}} ventral hangar just as Kenobi arrived there with Cody and their men. Kenobi helped bring Engle to safety inside the [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic shield]], while [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|contained]] the [[Fire/Legends|blaze]] from the wreckage of his Y-wing starfighter.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

===Republic collapse===
{{Quote|This is General Kenobi. Abandon ship. Abandon ship.''"<br />"''Sir, shouldn't we stay and fight? We can't lose the ship now.''"<br />"''Cody, this ship is already lost. We must face it. You and I are going to give Grievous a little ''parting gift''.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Cody, deciding to activate the ''Negotiator''{{'s}} self-destruct sequence|<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />}}
The 212th Attack [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] was given little [[Time/Legends|time]] to prepare its defenses, for four Vulture droids then landed in walking mode alongside the B1 and B2 battle droids, which followed Grievous and his two [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] into the ''Negotiator''{{'s}} hangar. A furious [[Lightfight|firefight]] erupted, with the 212th's only cover from the enemy droids being the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and various starfighters docked in the hangar. Members of the [[clone flight crew]] took up [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] alongside the 212th [[Troop/Legends|troops]], who tried to push forward but were summarily overrun. As Kenobi and Cody entered the firefight, Grievous approached them from the other end of the hangar, butchering every single trooper in his path with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], while his IG-100 MagnaGuards additionally joined the fight. He and Kenobi met in the middle and began a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], fiercely [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaging]] in a saberlock while the clones and droids continued to battle around them.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

[[File:YoullRegretThat-BFR.png|thumb|right|290px|Grievous chokes a clone trooper before confronting Kenobi in lightsaber combat.]]
After Grievous kicked him backward, Kenobi hit the side of an LAAT/i [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], where Cody pointed out one of the craft's [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] barrels to him. Kenobi used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|hurl]] the barrel at Grievous, and Cody placed a [[DC-15S/Legends|blaster]] shot on the flying projectile, detonating it and temporarily hindering Grievous so that they could escape from the hangar. With the battle droids pursuing them into the interior hallways, Kenobi, recognizing that his flagship had fallen to the Separatists, ordered all personnel aboard the ''Negotiator'' to abandon ship. Before joining the rest of the survivors at the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] launch bay, Kenobi and Cody initiated their cruiser's [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct sequence]] as a "parting gift" for Grievous. By that time, the ''Negotiator'' and another ''Venator''-class [[Star/Legends|Star]] Destroyer were all that remained of Kenobi's fleet. Their crews continued to return fire at the Separatist armada, destroying one of the ''Munificent''-class frigates, but their main [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|DBY-827 turbolaser batteries]] were soon disabled by Vulture droid assaults.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

Aboard the ''Negotiator'', a squad of B1 battle droids reached the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and eliminated the clone naval [[Officer/Legends|officers]], securing the warship just as Grievous arrived with his IG-100 MagnaGuards. Grievous ordered the battle droids to scour the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems for military intelligence, but he hurriedly made for the hangar upon learning of the active self-destruct mode from a [[holograph]]ic message that Kenobi had left for him. Four escape pods jettisoned with Kenobi, Cody, and their remaining troops aboard at the same time that Grievous escaped from the ''Negotiator'' aboard his ''Sheathipede''-class [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], mere [[Standard second|seconds]] before the ship self-destructed. The obliteration of the ''Negotiator'' consumed the entirety of the boarding party that Grievous had brought aboard.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I'm afraid the younglings are now on their own.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, following the destruction of the ''Negotiator''|<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />}}
[[File:NegotiatorDestroyed-BFR.png|thumb|left|300px|Kenobi, Cody, and the other survivors jettison from the ''Negotiator'' in escape pods.]]
With the annihilation of Kenobi's task force, Grievous's assault resulted in a Confederate victory, though the ''Negotiator'' fell before the Separatists could gain access to the information stored in its databanks. The destruction of their fleet cut Kenobi and Cody off from the Jedi younglings, who were meanwhile forced to land the ''Crucible'' on Florrum on account of an engine problem. The Jedi Initiates launched a [[Rescue on Florrum/Legends|mission]] to rescue Ahsoka Tano, posing as [[Animal Instincts/Legends|performers]] in a [[Circus/Legends|circus]] troupe known as [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]] so as to infiltrate Hondo Ohnaka's pirate base.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

With Kenobi's fleet decimated, Grievous moved in unopposed with his armada and seized control of the<ref name="A Necessary Bond">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]'<ref name="Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref> [[Florrum system/Legends|Florrum system]],<ref name="A Necessary Bond" /> which the Republic had held up until that point.<ref name="Revival" /> Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], having been previously captured and held for ransom by the Ohnaka Gang, ordered Grievous to launch an assault on Florrum in retribution for Ohnaka's actions. Although Grievous [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|demolished]] the pirate base, Ohnaka and several of his pirates survived the attack with the aid of Tano and the Jedi Initiates, who banded together with them against Grievous, their common enemy. After escaping from Florrum, Ohnaka transported Tano and the six Initiates to Kenobi, who had transferred to his new flagship, another ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer, with Cody and their surviving clone trooper crew.<ref name="A Necessary Bond" />

The loss of the ''Negotiator''&mdash;along with other debacles like the following [[Carida Incident]],<ref name="Facebook: Tarkin">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsTheCloneWars|url=photo.php?fbid=494382640601035|date=2013-01-15|quote=We swiped this eye-opening memo from the desk of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.... could this be a sign of the times?|archivedate=20151103191914|archivefile=File:Memo.jpg}}</ref> in which all personnel at the [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]] were nearly killed due to a Separatist [[Terrorist/Legends|terror]] plot<ref name="Point of No Return">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>&mdash;prompted critics of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], such as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] of the Republic Navy, to further question the Jedi's capability as serving as [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Tarkin himself [[Reformation of Jedi military command|sent his misgivings]] directly to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], lobbying for alternatives to [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] leadership being entrusted to the Jedi.<ref name="Facebook: Tarkin" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It's always nice to see the battle between Obi-Wan and Grievous and how they end up. With this one, I think Grievous definitely leaves a mark that Obi-Wan's going to be feeling in the morning.|Matthew Wood|<ref name="Bound for Rescue Featurette">{{SW|url=video/machinations-and-motivations-being-general-grievous|series=Clone Wars Download|text=Machinations and Motivations: Being General Grievous}}</ref>}}
[[File:KenobiDuelsGrievous-BFR.png|thumb|right|290px|The battle featured yet another encounter between old rivals Grievous and Kenobi.]]
The attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet was created for "[[Bound for Rescue]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /> Prior to the release of "Bound for Rescue"<ref name="S5 Trailer">{{SW|url=video/star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-5-commercial|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season 5 Commercial}}</ref> on [[November 17]], [[2012]],<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> scenes from the battle were previewed in a [http://www.starwars.com/watch/tcw_season5_trailer.html trailer] for the fifth season in [[June]] 2012.<ref name="S5 Trailer" /> As noted by [[Matthew Wood]], the series' voice actor for General Grievous, the battle featured another encounter between longtime foes Grievous and Kenobi,<ref name="Bound for Rescue Featurette" /> whose rivalry had been previously established throughout the series.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref><ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref><ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref> It also depicted the destruction of the ''Negotiator'',<ref name="Explore: Bound for Rescue" /> which had been created for the series as Kenobi's flagship.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> A location for the battle has yet to be established, as "Bound for Rescue" did not specify one. [[Holocron continuity database]] manager [[Leland Chee]] has stated that it was far off "enough" from the Florrum [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the point that Kenobi intended to send Commander Cody to rescue the Jedi Initiates.<ref name="Facebook Chee: Location" />

At one point in "Bound for Rescue," a tactical [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] on the ''Negotiator''{{'s}} bridge shows that there are three ''Munificent''-class star frigates in the Confederate fleet. This is inconsistent with the rest of the battle sequence, in which only two frigates are depicted.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /> This article assumes that the latter is correct.
